datasets.name: boreholes
datasets.title: Boreholes (well master)
datasets.description: Well/borehole master data (API number, operator, location, depths, status). One row per borehole.

datasets.name: well_completions
datasets.title: Well completions
datasets.description: Well completion history from the API Lookup raw data (mv_api_wellcomps_all.txt). One row per completion (API12 + production interval code) per completion/status record: a completion re-completed or re-classified appears more than once. Same zip also carries the API well list (mv_api_list_all.txt), not staged yet.

datasets.name: field_leases
datasets.title: Field-lease crosswalk
datasets.description: Field Names Master List Part One. Field code (e.g. GC743) to lease assignments with area/block, EIA field code, designated operator, effective/expiration month and the portion of the lease in the field. Grain: field x lease x effective period (6,368 rows). The field code is field_name_code in OGOR-A and BOEM_FIELD in the sands atlas.

datasets.name: sands_atlas
datasets.title: Atlas of Gulf of Mexico gas and oil sands
datasets.description: Atlas of Gulf of America Gas and Oil Sands, newest annual edition listed on the G&G page (2023 edition: data as of 2023-12-31, published 2026-06). Access database + xlsx + geodatabase. Sands carry field, pool, play, chronozone, reserves, cumulative production and sand-average petrophysics. The oper-comp crosswalk maps completions (WELL_API + PIC = completion_id) to sands; join it to sands on BOEM_FIELD + SAND. Table names are prefixed with the edition year.

datasets.name: bhp_surveys
datasets.title: Bottom-hole pressure surveys
datasets.description: Bottomhole Pressure Survey raw data. Shut-in and static pressure/temperature by depth station (MD/TVD) per survey, with field, lease, completion name, API12, operator reservoir name and remarks (often perforations and gradient). 286,515 station rows, 34,757 surveys, 14,415 wells, 1958-2024. No production interval code: map to completions through API12 + lease + completion name (unique for about 56% of keys; the rest need reservoir name to disambiguate).

datasets.name: well_tests
datasets.title: Well tests
datasets.description: Specified Well Test Detail Report (5140/5142), PDF only. Per completion (API12 + production interval code) and test date: test type (SEM, QTR, POT, COM), method, product, test hours, choke, SIBHP (rarely filled), shut-in, flowing tubing and casing pressure, test volumes, oil / gas / water rates, GOR (9999999 when the oil rate is 0), BS&W, API gravity, gas gravity, gas disposition. Six PDFs, ~172 MB, 40,743 pages, 448,137 records, republished monthly. Machine-generated with a full text layer (no OCR); blank cells are dropped from the text, so staging places words by coordinates (transform/well_test_pdf.py).

datasets.name: well_file_inventory
datasets.title: Well file inventory
datasets.description: File Request System well file inventory (mv_frs_file_inventory.txt, 371 MB unzipped): one row per available well document (1.93M files, 56,357 wells) with DOC_TYPE, API12, lease, area/block, run date, file size and extension. DOC_TYPE "Raw Log Samples" (16,078 zips, 6,518 boreholes, ~453 GB, 2004+) are the operator-submitted digital logs (LAS 2.0 / DLIS / LIS). The files themselves are requested through the File Request System, not downloaded here. `DOC_ID` is the "Filename ID" the FRS Well Data query accepts as an uploaded list.

datasets.name: leases
datasets.title: Leases
datasets.description: Lease area/block, status, effective/expiration dates

datasets.name: lease_data
datasets.title: Lease tape (royalty rates)
datasets.description: "All Releasable Lease Data Information" (lease tape, lsetapefixed.zip, ~1.1 MB): one record per lease with royalty rate, lease dates, status and bid terms. Needed for estimated net revenue interest (record-title share x (1 - royalty rate)) in the web app (TCD-014).

datasets.name: lease_owners
datasets.title: Lease owners
datasets.description: Record title ownership and operating rights by lease

datasets.name: platforms
datasets.title: Platforms and structures
datasets.description: Platform complexes and structures (location, install/removal dates)

datasets.name: companies
datasets.title: Companies
datasets.description: Company/operator registry (company number, name)

datasets.name: production_lease
datasets.title: Production by lease
datasets.description: "Production Data" raw download. Monthly oil, gas, condensate and water volumes by lease, all years in one file (~15 MB zipped, ~56 MB unzipped). Also contains small production-by-water-depth summary files.

datasets.name: production_completion
datasets.title: Production by completion
datasets.description: OGOR-A well production (Gulf of America). Monthly oil, gas, water, injection and days on production per completion (API12 + production interval code). One zip per year back to 1996; we keep all 31 years listed on the OGOR-A page (the current year is ogoradelimit.zip, e.g. Jan-Jun 2026) and stage them as one table.

datasets.name: pipeline_locations
datasets.title: Pipeline locations
datasets.description: Pipeline segment locations

datasets.name: pipeline_permits
datasets.title: Pipeline permits
datasets.description: Pipeline segment permits

datasets.name: incident_investigations
datasets.title: Incident investigations
datasets.description: Incident investigation reports (small file). The broader incident statistics are published on bsee.gov, not the data center; not yet registered.

datasets.name: incs
datasets.title: Incidents of noncompliance
datasets.description: Incidents of Non-Compliance issued during inspections

datasets.name: field_names_appendix_c
datasets.title: Field names, Appendix C
datasets.description: Field Names Master List Appendix C: the nickname for a field, where one exists. Field codes (MC807, GC640) are all the production data carries; this is what turns them into names people use. Covers about 123 of the 287 fields producing in 2025.

datasets.name: field_names_appendix_a
datasets.title: Field names, Appendix A
datasets.description: Field Names Master List Appendix A: area and block to field. An independent route from a block to its field, where Part One goes lease to field.

datasets.name: field_names_appendix_b
datasets.title: Field names, Appendix B
datasets.description: Field Names Master List Appendix B: lease to field, sorted by lease.

datasets.name: production_planning_area
datasets.title: Production by planning area
datasets.description: Production by planning area (Western, Central, Eastern Gulf). The lookup the Gulf-wide page needs: area codes carry no planning area, and the atlas only covers completions it has mapped.

datasets.name: ewell_eor
datasets.title: eWell end-of-operations reports
datasets.description: eWell End of Operations Reports: hydrocarbon intervals and perforations per completion. The best public signal for commingling — 10% of 2025 oil is on completions with two or more hydrocarbon intervals, against 0.5% by the atlas crosswalk's sand count.

datasets.name: paleo_reports
datasets.title: Paleontology reports
datasets.description: Releasable paleontological reports: biostratigraphic tops per well by MD and TVD, with definite / possible, at / in, age text (series, stage, marker fossil) and ecozone. Header table is one row per report per well. Candidate source for chronozone by depth.

datasets.name: ewell_war
datasets.title: eWell well activity reports
datasets.description: eWell Well Activity Reports: the drilling record — daily operations, depths and status per well. The source for wells drilled per year by operator (report plan category 6). mv_war_main_prop_remark.txt (288 MB of free-text remarks) is deliberately out of scope and not staged; the 7 structured tables are.

datasets.name: ewell_apd
datasets.title: eWell applications for permit to drill
datasets.description: eWell Applications for Permit to Drill. Planned wells with proposed depths and targets; leading indicator of drilling activity. Its own mv_apd_main.txt is a near-duplicate of permits_apd's mv_apd_main_all.txt (verified byte-identical on every shared column for all 20,003 shared SN_APD values; the permits_apd copy carries 150 more rows and an extra REGION_CODE column), so it is not restaged here — see permits_apd__main. Only the question/answer tables are staged; mv_apd_main_prop (ambiguous duplicate coordinates), mv_apd_attachments, mv_apd_casing_intervals, mv_apd_casing_sectons and mv_apd_geologic are drilling-engineering / file-metadata detail outside the current report scope.

datasets.name: permits_apd
datasets.title: Permits to drill (APD)
datasets.description: Applications for Permit to Drill (the older APD raw data extract). mv_apd_main_all.txt is the fuller copy of the master APD record (see ewell_apd); mv_apddata_all.txt is a genuinely older, simpler pre-eWell extract (APD_RECEIVED_DT back to 1998) not published elsewhere.

datasets.name: plans
datasets.title: Exploration and development plans
datasets.description: Exploration and development plans, with planned well and structure sites. The development pipeline ahead of permits.

datasets.name: production_platform
datasets.title: Production by platform
datasets.description: Production by platform, monthly. Throughput per structure — the basis for the facility spare-capacity view, since design capacity is not published and has to be inferred from a peak in earlier years.

datasets.name: facility_measurement_points
datasets.title: Facility measurement points
datasets.description: Facility measurement points, meters and tanks — where production is measured.

datasets.name: directional_surveys
datasets.title: Directional surveys
datasets.description: Directional survey points: the well path, station by station. Bottom-hole locations are already in boreholes; this is the trajectory between them, and it belongs in ArcGIS rather than Power BI. The master API list says which wells have a survey.

datasets.name: velocity_surveys
datasets.title: Velocity (check-shot) surveys
datasets.description: Velocity (check-shot) surveys — time-depth pairs per well. Last published years ago.

datasets.name: blocks
datasets.title: Lease blocks
datasets.description: OCS Mapping blocks polygons (shapefile): one row per area/block with protraction area, planning area and a centroid, for dim_block.

datasets.name: planning_areas
datasets.title: Planning areas
datasets.description: Gulf planning area outlines (shapefile, NAD27): three polygons coded WGM / CGM / EGM in MMS_PLAN_AREA_CD. Gives dim_block its planning area by a centroid-in-polygon join, since blocks.planning_area is NULL on every row and no tabular source carries it per block.

datasets.name: decommissioning_costs
datasets.title: Decommissioning cost estimates
datasets.description: Decommissioning cost estimates per structure — the idle-infrastructure view.
